title: Fixed Open Bell Cup and Long Straight Handle Plunger
description: One newly authored complete static bell-cup drain-plunger exterior. One continuous thick bell-shaped cup has a genuine broad open mouth, a finite rolled lower rim, a deep inner cavity and a narrow upper handle seat. A complete long straight turned-profile handle runs from within the cup neck to one full rounded cap grip. The three whole new parts are presented in one rigid resting pose, with the open mouth facing the front and both cup rim and far grip touching the ground datum. All cup profile, long handle and cap geometry newly authored, not a counter-service bell with its base deleted or a thimble enlarged and given a shaft. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole bounds-centred origin. One original model zero scenes. Static artistic geometry only: no flexible rubber, suction, airtight seal, drainage, pressure, cleaning, chemical compatibility, grip fit, hygienic suitability, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
